description: This file defines the SiloConnectionOptions class in the Orleans.Configuration namespace, which provides configuration options for silo networking, including methods to configure outbound and inbound connections for silos and gateways, and implements the ISiloConnectionBuilderOptions interface.

classes.name: SiloConnectionOptions
classes.description: Class providing configuration options for silo networking in Orleans, including methods to set up outbound and inbound connections.

classes.name: SiloConnectionOptions.ISiloConnectionBuilderOptions
classes.description: Interface defining methods to configure silo outbound, inbound, and gateway inbound connection builders.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloOutboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo outbound connections using a delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from other silos.

methods.name: ConfigureGatewayInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from clients via a delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloOutboundBuilder
methods.description: Method to configure the silo outbound connection builder, part of the interface.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloInboundBuilder
methods.description: Method to configure the silo inbound connection builder, part of the interface.

methods.name: ConfigureGatewayInboundBuilder
methods.description: Method to configure the gateway inbound connection builder, part of the interface.
